summary: Iter23. Backend: 10/10 tests pass in the new test_iter23_mascot_back.py. Mascot POST/GET/DELETE works, non-admins and guests get 401/403, and an empty image gets 400. Wardrobe back-image POST/DELETE works and GET /wardrobe shows back_url. Unknown ids get 404, non-admins are rejected, and create with back_image works. Frontend: BUG FIXED, the opening video now fits the screen. At 390x844 the <video> box is 390x844 with object-fit contain (videoWidth 1080x1920), so the whole frame shows with letterbox bars. Same result at 375x667 and 768x1024. It autoplays muted (currentTime 2.4 then 4.4s) and LEWATI goes to /login. Dressing Room as admin: the MASKOT LOBI panel uploads through the file chooser. UPLOAD changes to GANTI, a preview shows and HAPUS appears. Long-pressing an item opens item-menu with upload-back, delete and cancel; clear-back only shows once a back image exists. Uploading a back image adds a '360°' badge that stays after reload. Rotating 180° switches the character layer to the back image (…b_xxx.png). Clear-back removes the badge. Delete (after the confirm) removes the slot. Cancel and tapping the overlay both close the sheet. Non-admins see no mascot panel, no badge, no menu on long-press and no '+' icons. Home: users with no outfit see lobby-mascot inside hero-mascot. A user with a saved outfit sees their CharacterStage layers, not the mascot. Regression: back goes to '/', and SAVE shows 'Tersimpan!', goes to '/' and replaces the mascot with the character. No deprecated packages detected (expo-video is used). Cleanup: all TEST_it23 data deleted. mascot_url was reset to null, and the leftover TEST_Iter9 description/socials were reset to null/{} as requested.

minor.issue: Stores the image in object storage before it checks that the item exists. An unknown item_id still uploads an orphan file and then returns 404. Do the find first, then the upload.
Replaced images are never removed from storage, and there is no check on content type (a non-image file is accepted and saved as .png).

issues: The 'GANTI GAYA' pill overlaps the head of the CharacterStage character at 375x667.

action_items: Optional: in wardrobe_set_back, check that the item exists before _store_image so no orphan uploads are created.
Optional: move the 'GANTI GAYA' pill so it does not cover the character's head on Home.
critical_code_review_comments: dressing-room.tsx: Slot is declared inside the component, so it is a new component type on every render and all slots remount on each state change. Hoist it or memoize it.
Back view: clothing layers without back_url fall back to the front image. This is acceptable, but when only the character has a back image the clothes still show their front.
test file must be run with -n 0 (pytest.ini enables xdist and module fixtures tear down sessions per worker).
seed_data_creation: TEST_it23_admin/fresh/dressed users, their sessions and 5 TEST_it23 wardrobe items were created and then deleted (seed_iter23_fe.py clean). mascot_url was reset to null. The leftover TEST_Iter9 description and socials in app_settings were reset to null/{} as the main agent asked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python /app/backend/tests/seed_iter23_fe.py seed|state|clean`. The tokens are TEST_tok_it23_admin, TEST_tok_it23_fresh and TEST_tok_it23_dressed; set them in localStorage 'cakmad.session_token'. Click opening-skip after every goto. For long-press on web, use mouse.down, wait 900ms, then mouse.up. Image uploads use page.expect_file_chooser. Run the backend tests with `pytest tests/test_iter23_mascot_back.py -n 0`.
rca_of_issue: Opening video zoom: on web, VideoView renders a <video> at its intrinsic 1080x1920 size unless it is given an explicit size. Wrapping it in an absoluteFill View with width/height 100% and contentFit=contain fixes it (verified with the bounding box).
